title: Phishing-to-Execution Kill Chain
description: An adversary delivers a macro-enabled document via email, executes PowerShell or WScript, and establishes persistence via scheduled task within 24 hours.

title: Credential Theft and Lateral Spread
description: Attacker dumps credentials from LSASS, uses Pass-the-Hash over NTLM (logon type 3), and performs remote discovery before moving to additional hosts.

title: Ransomware Pre-Stage Activity
description: Shadow copies are deleted via vssadmin, backup services stopped, and mass file encryption follows within a 2-hour window.

title: DNS Tunneling C2 Channel
description: Beaconing via long subdomain labels and TXT record queries to the same rare domain from multiple internal hosts indicates DNS-based C2.

title: LOLBin Defense Evasion Pipeline
description: Sequential use of certutil for download, regsvr32 for execution, and msiexec for silent install suggests staged payload delivery without traditional malware.

title: Bulk Data Exfiltration via Egress
description: Large outbound transfers exceeding 500MB/hour to rare external IPs correlate with prior archive staging on the same source host.

title: Insider Privilege Escalation
description: A standard user account creates a new local administrator account and adds it to privileged groups outside of normal change windows.

title: Password Spray with Eventual Compromise
description: Low-and-slow failed authentication across many accounts from a single source IP, followed by one successful logon, indicates password spraying.
